rules.evidence: every-turn files present; no budget declared in a format this checker reads
planning files declared in roadkeep.toml, and a PreToolUse guard is wired
every commit adds at most one ledger entry
5 instruction file(s) scanned, no piped gate
on push: gates.yml, roadkeep.yml, site.yml
line terminators declared in .gitattributes
Tool, list, skill and response budgets have reasons beside them and are enforced by tests.
Every name in the shipped skill and specs is checked against the registry and the code.
CI installs editable and tests the checkout; no test loads the MCP server or skill from a built or installed artefact.
Adoption claims name Cottony and a counted change there.
CLAUDE.md says five constraints bind the project while docs/ROADMAP.md lists six non-goals, and nothing checks the count.
[limits] are enforced by the roadkeep write path.
No house style is declared beyond the fill width roadkeep applies.
No commit bundles several finished tasks; parts are marked.
The prescribed commit tool stages the whole tree while the audit skill expects other sessions to share the checkout.
Titles carry no task id and bodies are generated bullets walking the diff.
Open lines and deferral entries each name a symptom.
The commit rules do not say whether commits carry attribution.
Claims are configured and tasks start through roadkeep brief.
The commit tool stages the whole tree, so in a shared checkout it stages outside any claim.
No commit-time hook is tracked.
The lock detects only another run of the gate itself, so a run disturbed by another session's edits still reports green or red.
The clone keeps no record of other sessions' uncommitted work when counts were taken.
The launcher declares the resolution order and roadkeep.toml pins the version.
Child output is decoded with the locale default; also loop.py:81-88 and tools/gate.py.
The shipped guard does not strip a byte-order mark, and its bare except then allows the call silently.
The PW73 encoding defect is checked on bytes.
The clone does not record which tool wrote source files.
Recorded breaches were moved into gates.
The no-clobber guard's rule has no gate in CI and no test.
no-clobber is matched only on Write, so a shell redirect can replace a file unguarded.
When no engine runs, the guard returns 0 silently, so the session is not told it is unguarded.
No test reads settings.json or .mcp.json; losing a PreToolUse or Stop entry fails nothing.
No gate in the tree compares the vendored copy with its source; the external lint action cannot be judged from the clone.
Work needing a person's judgement is set aside rather than shipped.
Bounds record a person as their origin, and the agent is told not to move them.
Open lines state symptoms.
The false premise under PW56 was recorded in the open.
Shipped entries point to where the design lives.
The site counts a block as built when nothing under it is open, regardless of its declared criteria.
Waiting work is recorded as deferrals with reasons.
Bash(*) is allowed with empty deny and ask lists, and nothing committed names what stands in.
Never pushing is prose only; no deny or ask rule and no guard refuses git push.
No credential-like file is tracked.
CI run results per commit are not in the clone.
Skipped tests are reported apart from passed, and a held lock exits without a verdict.
The gate tallies the JUnit report and never compares it with the tests collected.
CI history is not in the clone.
No gate is recorded as kept red while work continued.
Sampled behaviour-changing commits each add or change a test.
Size budgets are set from measured values written beside them.
The every-turn file holds purpose, gates and commit rule, and points to specs and skills for the rest.
Skill descriptions name the occasions they load on.
Only skills/polyweave has a ceiling; nothing bounds docs/specs (196 KB the agent is sent to), the audit skill or the roadkeep pages.
Config keys and paths named in the audit skill and CLAUDE.md are not checked against their source.
The served MCP schemas are held under budgets by tests that CI runs.
